title: The Mantis Shrimp's Unimaginable Vision
hook: What if an animal could see colors you can't imagine?
script: What if an animal could see colors you can't imagine? The mantis shrimp has a vision system that defies human comprehension. This creature's eye contains up to 10,000 lenses, allowing it to detect details others miss. Unlike us, it sees circularly polarized light using a unique mechanism in its eye. Yet, they also throw some of the fastest punches in nature, creating shockwaves that can boil water. Imagine a creature that sees colors you can't even name and strikes faster than you can blink.
